alerts.askPhone: Tell me when an agent is finished or needs me

inbox.label: Notifications
inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyDescription: Ahab tells you here when an agent finishes, needs you or stops.

page.title: Notifications
page.description: What Ahab tells you about: an agent that finishes, needs you or stops. They are kept in the inbox (the bell in the top bar), and shown on every client paired with this server.

enabled.title: Notifications
enabled.description: Everything below; off sends none at all.

outside.heading: Outside Ahab
outside.title: Show them outside the app
outside.phone: As the phone's notifications, while agents work, with Ahab closed too.
outside.desktop: As the desktop's notifications, while this app runs (also in the tray).
outside.browser: As this browser's notifications: while a tab is open, or even when Ahab is closed once this browser gets them.

keeping.heading: Keeping them
keeping.title: Read notifications
keeping.description: Unread ones are always kept. Read ones are deleted after this long, once a day.
keeping.label: Keep read notifications

sound.heading: Sound
sound.title: Play a sound
sound.description: As a notification arrives, on this device. Kept in this browser or app.

phone.title: This phone
phone.connected: Connected: notifications arrive while agents work, with Ahab closed too.
phone.allowed: Allowed: Ahab connects while agents work, and checks every 15 minutes.
phone.blocked: Blocked: allow Ahab's notifications in Android's settings.

stayConnected.title: Stay connected even when nothing runs
stayConnected.description: Tells you at once about everything, with an ongoing notification; uses a little more battery.

late.title: Notifications come late?
late.description: Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. Let Ahab run unrestricted in its battery settings.

push.title: This browser
push.insecureAllowed: While a tab is open. Notifications when Ahab is closed need HTTPS (or localhost).
push.insecure: Notifications when Ahab is closed need HTTPS (or localhost); while a tab is open, this browser can still show them.
push.tabOnly: While a tab is open: this browser cannot get them when Ahab is closed.
push.blocked: Blocked: allow notifications for this site in the browser's settings.
push.testSent: On. A test is on its way.
push.testFailed: On, but the test did not reach the browser's push service.
push.on: On: notifications arrive even when Ahab is closed.
push.off: Off: notifications show only while a tab is open.
